Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was
struck while turning left. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the
kind and force of the impact, and the presenting complaint involved the right knee.
Over the course of care, the patient attended 22 visits for evaluation and
rehabilitation. Treatment followed a typical progression, beginning with conservative
measures including physical therapy, activity modification, and anti-inflammatory
medication, and frequency of visits tapered as symptoms improved and range of motion
returned. Examination findings were mixed: several orthopedic tests reproduced knee
pain and showed mild effusion, supporting the reported injury, while other ligamentous
and neurovascular assessments returned within normal limits. The ptaient reports no
prior injury or traetment to this body area. Billed services were reviewed and each
reflects a distinct, mediaclly indicated encounter with no duplicate charges
identified. Patient was discharged to home exercise program with instructions for
follow-up as needed.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
